# 🌮 Taco Launcher (beta)

A free home screen app for Android, made for the **GameSir Pocket Taco** clip-on controller.
Clip your phone in and Taco Launcher switches to a console-style game menu that fits in the part of
the screen the Taco leaves visible, and you can do everything with the controller. Take the Taco off
and you get a normal home screen.

> **Beta:** so far this has only been tested on a **Samsung Galaxy S26 Ultra**. It should work on any
> phone with Android 10 or newer, but it may need adjusting on yours. Please
> [tell us how it went](https://github.com/joeywbarker/taco-launcher/issues/new/choose), even if it all worked.

## Install

1. Download the **.apk** file below (under *Assets*) on your phone and open it.
2. If Android asks, allow installing apps from your browser or files app.
3. Press Home, choose **Taco Launcher**, and tap **Always**.
4. Follow the short first-run setup. It asks how much of the screen your Taco covers, with a live preview.

To go back to your old home screen: Settings → Apps → Default apps → Home app.

## What it does

- **Turns on by itself** when the Pocket Taco connects (put the Taco in Android mode: hold **M + A** for 2 seconds).
- **Fits any phone.** Menus, game windows and game pictures all sit above the controller.
- **Fully controller-driven:** D-pad to move, A to pick, B to go back. Teach it your buttons and set hotkeys.
- **Your games sorted by console:** GB, GBC, GBA, NES, SNES, Genesis, arcade and many more, with
  console artwork, Quick Start, Recent, Favorites and Random.
- **RetroArch set up automatically every launch.** No RetroArch settings to change by hand:
  the picture and the menu stay above the Taco, **Select + Start** opens the menu, **Select + R1 / L1** save and load.
- **Also works with** Lemuroid, My Boy!, DraStic, DuckStation, PPSSPP, Flycast, MAME4droid and more.
- **Settings for everything,** each one explained in plain words, plus backup & restore.

## You'll need

- Android 10 or newer.
- An emulator app. **RetroArch** (free) is recommended. Download the cores you want inside it, for example mGBA for Game Boy Advance.
- Your own game files. **No games are included.**
- Hotkeys need the button helper: Settings → Accessibility → Installed apps → Taco Launcher. The app points you there.

## Known limits

- Only tested on one phone so far (Galaxy S26 Ultra).
- Other controllers work if you turn on "Treat any controller as a Pocket Taco", but they haven't been tested much.

## Found a problem?

[Report it here](https://github.com/joeywbarker/taco-launcher/issues/new/choose). Your phone model helps the most.
